rationale.conceptual: The method is an established DFT+U variant using existing HP code, but reproducing it requires understanding the self-consistent procedure (alternating SCF, DFPT, relaxation), handling meta-stable states, and correctly setting up projection schemes. It is non-trivial and multi-component, but not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves iterative self-consistent loops for four configurations (each 6-8 cycles of SCF, hp.x, relax), plus final band gap calculations. Needs compilation of QE with HP, fetching pseudopotentials, and careful scripting of convergence checks. A multi-stage pipeline with dependencies, but not overly long or fragile.
